title: Swedish letters to Axel Oxenstierna, June 1633 (Riksarkivet, Oxenstiernska samlingen E 708, DECODE R4338-R4341; from catalogue item 207)

steps.what: Fetched the 14 DECODE records of catalogue 207 with the project cookie; R4338-R4341 (Oxenstiernska samlingen E 708) are Swedish letters to Oxenstierna dated June 1633 (DECODE: 1646), mostly clear with numerical codes, part deciphered between the lines at the time. Surveyed only.

Split from the former catalogue-207 group entry riksarkivet1628 under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026); E 708 is another correspondence and code. Image 1 of R4338 viewed again (codes 1328, 1504, 3143, 3192, 3597 with interlinear glosses). Not transcribed, not attacked.

Riksarkivet's catalogue (data.riksarkivet.se, records ucDQuPya1QLMUpVXdAiro7 and 2hhZg3ZsE4zMgKbE9OaND7): Oxenstiernska samlingen, Axel Oxenstierna, incoming letters, volumes SE/RA/720701/II/01/B/I/E 708 A and E 708 B are both titled 'Salvius, Johan Adler'. The series is filed by writer, so the E 708 letters of June 1633 are most probably Johan Adler Salvius's. Both volumes are analog only (not digitised by Riksarkivet), so the DECODE photographs remain the only images. Not checked against the hand or the signatures on the images.

Integration check of the 14 Nov literature step: the two Riksarkivet records re-fetched as JSON-LD (data.riksarkivet.se/archive/<id>.jsonld): both named 'Salvius, Johan Adler', reference codes E 708 A and E 708 B in series SE/RA/720701/II/01/B/I, instantiation Analog; date ranges E 708 A 1613-1634, E 708 B 1635-1646 (so the June 1633 leaves fall in E 708 A by date). E 744 'Tungel-Törnsköld' confirmed in the records API (uFzydVoaGf5iqAIHHtCyq3). Writer kept as probable: hand and signatures not compared.

outcome.method_basis: Surveyed only: the four letters were opened and their code noted, but the codes and the interlinear decipherments were not transcribed or used.
outcome.fraction_read_source: No transcription; no group read here (some glossed at the time).

gaps.detail: surveyed only; the interlinear decipherments of the time are unused; the Tungel 1633 key not identified among the 70 fetched key records; writer probably Salvius (archive filing), not checked on the hand; a Salvius code not yet searched among the key records

outcome.notes: Split on 14 Oct 2026 from riksarkivet1628. In progress: not yet worked; the interlinear glosses are the obvious start.

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
